unique_selling_points: Benchmarks publicados top-of-class: 91.6 LoCoMo (+20 vs old), 93.4 LongMemEval (+26), 64.1 BEAM (1M)
Maior ecossistema de providers: 24 LLMs + 30 vector stores + 15 embeddings + 4 graphs + 5 rerankers
Hosted + self-hosted: escolher managed service ou rodar local/docker
Polyglot monorepo: Python core + TS SDK + CLIs + UI + Vercel + OpenClaw
YC S24 com arxiv paper e eval framework open-source
Entity linking: entities extraidas, embedded e linkadas across memories pra boost retrieval

limitations.description: Telemetry core (posthog em dependencies core, nao extra)
OpenAI default para LLM + embedding, requer API key pra caminho happy
Paraphrase-first: summarized memories, nao armazenamento verbatim
Graph memory requer Neo4j/Memgraph externo (nao embutido)
